title.en: Constitution of the Republic of Benin (11 December 1990)

description.ko: 국민회의 이후 1990년 12월 국민투표로 채택되고 법률 제90-32호로 공포된 베냉 헌법의 원래 본문. 대통령 5년 임기 1회 연임과 40~70세 후보 연령, 헌법재판소·경제사회이사회·시청각통신고등기구, 쿠데타에 맞선 불복종의 권리와 의무를 정했다.
description.en: The original text of Benin's constitution, adopted by referendum in December 1990 after the National Conference and promulgated as Law No. 90-32. It set a five-year presidential term renewable once, a candidate age range of 40 to 70, a Constitutional Court, an Economic and Social Council and a High Authority for Audiovisual and Communication, and made disobedience to a coup a right and a duty.

source: Loi n° 90-32 du 11 décembre 1990 portant Constitution de la République du Bénin, Journal officiel de la République du Bénin, 102e année, n° 1, 1er janvier 1991. Text: Digithèque MJP (Jean-Pierre Maury), https://mjp.univ-perp.fr/constit/bj1990.htm; promulgation formula and signatures from ConstitutionNet (https://constitutionnet.org/sites/default/files/Benin%20const.%20fr.pdf) and WIPO Lex BJ001 (https://www.wipo.int/wipolex/fr/text/490646); three copies collated word by word, accessed 2026-10-07. Original 1990 text (before the 2019 revision). National constitution; not subject to copyright.
